newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate to vote power regulator bill Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate to vote power regulator bill Thurs.

text.p: Brazil's Senate will vote Thursday on a bill creating a new power regulator to oversee the increasingly privately owned industry, a Senate official said.
The Senate voted in favor of a request that the bill, which has already been approved in the Chamber of Deputies, be given priority treatment, the official said.
The National Electric Energy Agency (ANEEL) would replace an existing regulator to oversee the production, transmission and distribution of electric power.
If approved by the Senate, the bill would require only the signature of President Fernando Henrique Cardoso before becoming law.
